peṣaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prāṇāya tveti prācīṃ prohedapānāya tveti pratīcīmvyānāya tveti tiraścīṃ karṣedatha prācīṃ proheddīrghāmanu prasitimāyuṣe dhāmiti
kṛṣṇājine piṣṭāni praskandayeddevo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātviti 
naikacarau dhṛṣṭerādānaṃ vidyate na bahuṣviti śālīkiratroha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva dhṛṣṭimādadīta dhṛṣṭirasi brahma yaccheti
gārhapatyamabhimantrayetāpāgne'gnimāmādaṃ jahīti
niṣkravyādam̐ sedheti dakṣiṇāṅgāraṃ nirasyedathānyānkalpayedā devayajaṃ vaheti
teṣu carusthālīmadhiśrayeddhruvāsi pṛthivīṃ dṛm̐ hāyurdṛm̐ ha prajāṃ dṛm̐ ha sajātānasmai yajamānāya paryūhety
athaināṃ pradakṣiṇamaṅgāraiḥ paricinuyādnirdagdham̐ rakṣo girdagdhā arātaya iti
sa evameva sarvāścarusthālīradhiśrayediti ||
carumukheṣviti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva dhṛṣṭimādadīta
mukhyādeva bhakṣānsādhayedityatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ kapālasaṃyojane khalu dhṛṣṭerādānaṃ bhavati
sa kapālānyevopadhāsyandhṛṣṭimādadīta
puroḍāśādeva bhakṣānsādhayediti ||
kapālānāmupadhāna iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāmnāyaṃ khalvasyaivaṃ kapālānyupahitāni bhavanti
ya evaiṣo'ṅgārādhivartato mantrastaṃ prathamaṃ kapālpodhānānāṃ kuryādatha tūṣṇīmaṅgāramadhivartayediti |
ekakapāle dvikapāla iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi caikakapālo yadi ca dvikapālaḥ sarvairenaṃ kapālamantrairupadadhyādityatro ha smāha śālīkiryathādhikaraṇameva kapālānyupadadhyādna tu yogābhyūhau gamayettapanamantraṃ cātra brūyādbhṛgūṇāmaṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasva tapyethāṃ tapyadhvamiti ||
kapālānāṃ yoga iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyava etairevāsyaitāni mantrairyuktāni yairupahitāni bhavantyathetaro vimocanamantra eva syāditi ||
madantīnāmadhiśrayaṇa iti ||
tiraḥ pavitramapa ānīyādhiśrayediti baudhāyano yathopapādamiti śālīkiḥ ||
saṃyavana iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ praṇītābhyaḥ sruveṇopahatyāpa ānayedevaṃ madantībhyas
tā ubhayīrānīyamānāḥ pratimantrayeta samāpo adbhiragmateti ||
vyabhimarśa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano vyabhimṛśedevaikahavirevaṃ nānābījānītyatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ sam̐ sargātkhalu vyabhimarśo jāyate
nāsam̐ sṛjyamānāni havīm̐ ṣi vyabhimṛśennaikahaviḥ
ko hi nānābījānāṃ vyabhimarśa iti ||
ājyasya nirvapaṇṇiti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkerākhyātaṃ baudhāyanasyātro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sarvāṇyeva havīm̐ ṣi pariniṣṭhāpyājyaṃ nirvapediti ||
āpyaninayana iti ||
jaghanena gārhapatyamāpyebhyo ninayediti baudhāyano'greṇātihāyeti śālīkiragreṇa vā jaghanena vetyaupamanyavaḥ 
sphyasya sam̐ śāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano ya eṣa sphyasyodasano mantrastaṃ prathamam̐ sam̐ śyanānāṃ kuryādatha tūṣṇīm̐ sphyamudasyediti ||
vedyai parigrahaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ śroṇiṃ prathamāṃ parigṛhṇīyādatha dakṣiṇamam̐ samathottaramiti
purastādevaināṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ parigṛhṇīyādityaupanyavaḥ ||
yoyupana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
caturthena yoyupitvā pañcamenodgṛhṇīyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
prokṣaṇīnāmāsādana iti ||
sphyasya vartmannupaninīyāsādayediti baudhāyano'nupaninīyaiveti śālīkiḥ ||
idhmābarhiṣorupasādana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyottaramidhmamiti śālīkiḥ 
vedaparivāsaneṣviti ||
pañcadhā vibhajya srucaḥ saṃmṛjediti baudhāyanaḥ
samastairevādbhirabhyākāramiti śālīkiḥ ||
prāśitraharaṇasya saṃmārjana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
tūṣṇīm̐ saṃmṛjediti śālīkirna saṃmṛjedityaupamanyavaḥ ||
sruksaṃmārjanānāmanupraharaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano'dbhirabhyukṣyāsaṃcara udasyedutkare vaivamidhmasaṃnahanānīti ||
patnīnām̐ saṃnahana iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ekaikāmāsām̐ saṃnahyedekaikāṃ gārhapatyamīkṣayedekaikāmājyamavekṣayedityatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ sakṛdevaināḥ sarvāḥ saṃnahyedekaikāṃ gārhapatyamīkṣayedekaikāmājyamavekṣayedityatro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sakṛdevaināḥ sarvāḥ saṃnahyetsakṛdgārhapatyamīkṣayedekaikāmājyamavekṣayedity
ekaikāmevāsām̐ sarveṇasarveṇa karmaṇā parinistiṣṭhedityaupamanyavīputraḥ ||
granthikaraṇa iti ||
avācīnapāśamūrdhvanirmocanamityācāryayorūrdhvapāśamavācīnanirmocanamiti dīrghavātsya evamiva hi prajāḥ prajāyanta iti ||
patnyāmavidyamānāyāmiti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yajamānāyatana āsīno yajamāna evaitānmantrānnigadedityatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ patnīsaṃyojakāḥ khalvete mantrā dṛṣṭā bhavanti
tasyāmavidyamānāyāṃ naivainānādri yeteti ||
athaināmājyamavekṣayatīti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ patnyā tadavekṣitamupayacchīta tejo'sītyathainacchakalenopayatya haredtejo'nu prehītyathainadāhavanīye'dhiśrayedagniste tejo mā vinaidityathainaddhṛtvottareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sādayitvāvekṣitvotpunuyādājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīriti ||
ājyasyāvekṣaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
sarvairevāvekṣitamājyamutpunuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||

sa ha smāha baudhāyano'dhvaryurevobhayairmantrairgṛhṇīyātpauroḍāśikaiśca yājamānaiśca
yājamānairyajamāno'numantrayetetyatro ha smāha śālīkiradhvaryurevobhayairmantrairgṛhṇīyātpauroḍāśikaiśca yājamānaiśca
na yājamānairyajamāno'numantrayetetyatro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāpi pauroḍāśikā mantrā nābhinivartanta evamevāpi yājamānā mantrā nābhinivarteranniti ||
idhmābarhiṣaḥ prokṣaṇa iti ||
tristrirekaikaṃ prokṣediti baudhāyanaḥ
sakṛtsakṛditi śālīkiḥ

sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanastiṣṭhandive tvetyagrāṇi prokṣetprahvo'ntarikṣāya tveti madhyānyupaviśya pṛthivyai tveti mūlāni
saha srucā purastātpratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣyātiśiṣṭāḥ prokṣāṇīrninayeddakṣiṇāyai śroṇerottarāyai śroṇeḥ svadhā pitṛbhya ūrgbhava barhiṣadbhya ūrjā pṛthivīṃ gacchateti ||
sruca udūhana iti ||
agreṇātmānamudīcīmudūhediti baudhāyano jaghanenātmānamudīcīmudūhediti śālīkiḥ ||

taṃ yajamānāya vā brahmaṇe vā prayacchatīti ||

śulbasyāyātana iti ||

āghārāviti ||

savyena pradāsyannatyākrāmeddhutvāmuto dakṣiṇeneti baudhāyano dakṣiṇena pradāsyannatyākrāmeddhutvāmutaḥ savyeneti śālīkiḥ

abhikrāmaṃ juhotīti ||

ājyabhāgayorhoma iti ||

madhyātpūrvārdhātpaścārdhātpañcāvattināmityaupamanyavaḥ ||
āhutīnāmāyatana iti ||

srucyamāghārapathamabhijuhuyādityaupamanyavo madhye pradakṣiṇaṃ maṇḍalākāramiti rāthītaraḥ ||
upām̐ śuyājasya karaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ maudgalyasyātro ha smāha baudhāyana auṣadhasyopām̐ śuyājaṃ kuryādagnīṣomīyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiṣṇavamamāvāsyāyāmityatro ha smāha śālīkirājyasyopām̐ śuyājaṃ kuryātsaumyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiṣṇavamamāvāsyāyāmityatro ha smāhaupamanyava auṣadhasyaivopām̐ śuyājaṃ kuryātsarasvataḥ paurṇamāsyām̐ sarasvatyā amāvāsyāyāmityubhayatraivājyasya vaiṣṇava iti rāthītaro'tro ha smāha kauṇapatantriścaruśca syādvaiṣṇavaśca syātsvayaṃ caiva yajamānaḥ prāśnīyāditi ||

anvāhāryasyodvāsana iti ||

anūyājānām̐ homa iti ||

prastarasya samañjana iti ||

sakṛtsakṛditi śālīkiḥ ||
prastarasyānupraharaṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano'dhvaryurevobhayairmantrairanupraharetpauroḍāśikaiśca yājamānaiśca
yājamānairyajamāno'numantrayetetyatro ha smāha śālīkiradhvaryurevobhayairmantrairanupraharetpauroḍāśikaiśca yājamānaiśca
na yājamānairyajamāno'numantrayetetyatro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāpi pauroḍāśikā mantrā nābhivartanta evamevāpi yājamānā mantrā nābhivarteranniti ||
paridhīnāmabhyādhāna iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya

athainānsam̐ srāveṇābhijuhotīti ||

srucorvimoka iti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
patnīsaṃyājeṣvṛtvijāṃ parikramaṇa iti ||

patnīnām̐ saṃyājana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
dhrauvājyena dhvānenaiva patnīḥ saṃyājayediti śālīkiḥ ||
antardhāya devānāṃ patnīḥ saṃyājayediti baudhāyano'nantardhāyaiveti śālīkiḥ ||
patnīsaṃyājeṣu śamyuvākasya karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
dhruvāyā āpyāyana iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhāveva dhruvāmāpyāyayetāmadhvaryuśca yajamānaścety
adhvaryureva dhruvāmāpyāyya samiṣṭayajurjuhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
samiṣṭayajuṣo homa iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāha gautamaḥ svāhā vācīti hutvā barhiṣo dhātūnām̐ saṃpralupya dhruvāyām̐ samajyānuprahṛtyābhijuhuyātsvāhā vāte dhāḥ svāheti 
athāto'gnyādheyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
saṃbhāreṣviti ||
sūtram̐ rāthītarāṇām
atro ha smāha baudhāyano nāśanihataṃ kurvīta ghorarūpamiti
kurvītaivāśanihataṃ na tu muñjakulāyaṃ na hyetasyānukhyā vijñāyata iti śālīkiḥ ||
pātrāṇāṃ karaṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanastvaktaāsecanāni kārayedagrataḥpuṣkarāṇyevamasya prācīnapuṣkarāḥ srucaḥ sannā bhavantītyatro ha smāha śālīkistvaktaāsecanāni kārayenmūlataḥpuṣkarāṇyevamasya prācīnapuṣkarāḥ srucaḥ sannā bhavantīti
vijñāyate tasmādavācīnāgrā vanaspatayaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṣiyantīti ||
srucāṃ pramāṇa iti ||
bāhumātrāḥ syuriti baudhāyano'ratnimātrā iti śālīkiḥ
prādeśamātrā ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
srucāmākṛtivikāra iti ||
hastyoṣṭhyaḥ syuriti baudhāyano vāyasapucchā iti śālīkiham̐ rsamukhaprasecanā ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
ambarīṣasya karaṇa iti ||
uttarato'gnyagārasyāmbarīṣaṃ kuryāditi baudhāyano yatraivāmbarīṣaḥ syāttadgacchediti śālīkiḥ ||
rohite carmaṇīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyāpyarohitam̐ syāditi śālīkiḥ ||
brahmaudanasya mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravānsyāditi baudhāyanastūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ ||
brahmaudanasya nirvapaṇa iti ||
pavitravatā pātreṇa mantravantamiti baudhāyano'pavitreṇa tūṣṇīkamiti śālīkiḥ ||
brahmaudanasya śrapaṇa iti ||
payasi śrapayediti baudhāyano'psviti śālīkiḥ ||
naivāsminnāsiñcenna niḥṣiñcediti baudhāyanaḥ
kāmamasminnāsiñcenna niḥṣiñcediti śālīkirvisrāvya tam̐ sūpavantamityaupamanyavaḥ ||
brahmaudanasyopastaraṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
nopastṛṇīteti śālīkiḥ ||

sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyātraiva paryupaviśeyuriti śālīkiḥ ||
brahmaudanasyopohana iti ||
yajño mopanamatviti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
brahmaudanasya prāśana iti ||
ārṣeyā eva brahmaudanaṃ prāśnīyuriti baudhāyano ya eva keca niyatapānā iti kātyo'tro ha smāhaupamanyavo mahartvija eva brahmaudanaṃ prāśnīyuratra hyevaite satānunaptriṇo bhavantīti ||
samidhāmabhyādhāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sakṛtprāśite'pratyavamṛṣṭe samidho'bhyajyādadhyādityatro ha smāhaupamanyavo'traivaināḥ pārśvataḥ samajya sādayet
te yadā sarvaṃ prāśnīyurathaitāṃ pātrīṃ nirṇijyopastīrya yatsthālyāmājyamavaśiṣṭam̐ syāttatsakṛdabhyunnīya tena samidho'bhyajyādadhyāditi ||
goḥ karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkirapi bahvīrapi kurvītānu caitasya bhavetpuṇyā praśam̐ seti kātyaḥ ||
araṇyoḥ pradāna iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo'pararātra evāsmā araṇī prayacchedvaraṃ dadāmītyeva vācaṃ visṛjediti ||
agnyāyatanānāṃ parilepana iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo gārhapatyāyatanamevaikaṃ parilimpet
taddhi vidagdhaṃ bhavatīti ||
saṃbhārāṇāṃ nivapana iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo gārhapatyāyatana evainānsarvairmantraiḥ pariniṣṭhāpya tredhā nivapediti 
idhmasya haraṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano jānudaghne prathamam̐ haredatha nābhidaghne'tha grīvadaghne
prāṇām̐ stu nātiharedityādadāna evaitā mātrā abhisaṃpādayet
prāṇām̐ stveva nātiharediti śālīkiḥ ||
saṃbhārāṇāmākramaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyana evamevaitena purastātpratyagāvṛttena dakṣiṇena pūrvapadenottarataḥ pārśvataḥ saṃbhārāṇāmākramayedyathāhitasyāgneraṅgārā abhyavavarteranniti ||
aśvasya dana iti ||
adhvaryava etamagnipadamaśvaṃ dadyādanyaṃ brahmaṇa iti baudhāyana etaṃ brahmaṇe'nyamadhvaryava iti śālīkiḥ ||
idhmasya nidhāna iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
tūṣṇīmevedhmaṃ nidadhyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
sabhyāvasathyayoḥ karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
sabhyāvasathyayorviharaṇa iti ||
āhavanīyādevainau viharediti baudhāyano grāmāgneriti śālīkirnirmanthyau syātāmityaupamanyavo'tro ha smāhaupamanyavīputraḥ sabhāyāmeva sabhyaṃ vyapadiśedāvasatha āvasathīyaṃ parvaṇi cainayo sthālīpākau śrapayitvā brahmaṇe juhuyādityetadapi na kuryādityāñjīgaviḥ ||
rathacakrasya karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiratro ha smāhaupamanyavo rathamevaitam̐ saṃyuktaṃ prāñcaṃ pravartayet
tamṛtvigbhyo dadyādityetadapi na kuryādityāñjīgaviḥ ||
tanūnāmanudeśa iti ||
pratyadhītyānudiśediti baudhāyano yāste agne ghorāstanuvastābhiramuṃ gacchetyeva brūyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
virājakrameṣviti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
narya prajāṃ me gopāya tyeva brūyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
pūrṇāhutyai havana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
pariśrita eva pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ 
pūrṇāhutau tūṣṇīmagnihotra iti ||
sūtram̐ rāthītarāṇām
atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pūrṇāhutimeva juhuyānna tūṣṇīmagnihotramiti
tūṣṇīmagnihotrameva juhuyānna pūrṇāhutimiti śālīkiḥ ||
daśahoturvyākhyāna iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yatra kvaca havirnirvapsyansyātsāmidhenīrvānuvakṣyanvyācakṣītaiva tatra daśahotāram
ityeṣvevaitadāgnyadheyikeṣu tantreṣu dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatīti śālīkirasminnevaitadāgneye'ṣṭākapāle dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītyaupamanyavaḥ ||
tantrakaraṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pañcadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syurvārtraghnāvājyabhāgāvuccairdevatā ityatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ saptadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syurvṛdhanvantāvājyabhāgāvupām̐ śudevatā ityatro ha smāhaupamanyava āgneye'ṣṭākapāle vārtraghnāvājyabhāgau syātāṃ vṛdhanvantāvaindrā gnādityayo rayimantau puṣṭimantau pavamānahaviḥṣu vītavantāvanvārambheṣṭyāmiti ||
yājamānasya karaṇa iti ||
abhīnāmaṃ yājamānaṃ kuryāditi baudhāyanaḥ ||
kuryādyathāvakāśaṃ yājamānamiti śālīkiḥ ||
dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarvā evaitā iṣṭīrdakṣiṇāvatīḥ kuryāt
tisrastisra ekaikasyāṃ dadyānmithunāvuttamāyāmiti ||
tantarasamāsa iti ||
nāsti tantrasamāsa ācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyava āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'gnaye pavamānāya tatprathamaṃ tantram̐ syādathāgnaye pāvakāyāgnaye śucaye taddvitīyam
athaindrā gnaścādityaśca carurantaṃ parīyātāmiti ||
dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkerākhyātaṃ baudhāyanasyātro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sarvā evaitā iṣṭīrdakṣiṇāvatīḥ kuryāccatasraścatasra ekaikasyāṃ dadyānmithunāvuttamāyāmiti ||
ananvārabdhadarśapūrṇamāsasya prāyaścittakaraṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
anvārambheṣṭyāmiti ||
caturhotāram̐ sārasvatau homāvanvārambheṣṭimityetadupavasathe kuryādathetaradiṣṭyahani kuryāditi baudhāyanaścaturhotāram̐ sārasvatau homāvityetadupavasthe kuryādathetaradiṣṭyahani kuryāditi śālīkiścaturhotāramevopavasathe kuryādathetaradiṣṭyahani kuryādityaupamanyavaḥ
sarvamevaitadiṣṭyahani kuryādityaupamanyavīputraḥ 
athātaḥ punarādheyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
sarparājñīṣviti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarparājñiyā ṛgbhirgārhapatyamādadhātīti tam̐ ṣaḍbhirādhāya saptamyopatiṣṭheteti ||
pūrṇāhutyai karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
tantrakaraṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayāni tantrāṇi kārayetpaunarādheyikāni cāgnyādheyikāni cāgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet
tasyāsamudite'gnyādheyadakṣiṇā dadyādathāgneyaṃ pañcakapālaṃ tasyāsamudite punarādheyadakṣiṇā dadyādathaindrā gnaṃ cādityaṃ ca carum
athāgnivāruṇampāre dvādaśāhasya tanva iti ||
vibhaktīnāṃ dhāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ savām̐ rsarvāmṛcamuktvā yajetetyāgneyīrdvyakṣarā vibhaktīrdadhyādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
puroḍāśasya parihoma iti ||
daivataṃ parijuhuyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
sasviṣṭakṛtkamiti śālīkiḥ ||
sviṣṭakṛto nirvacana iti ||
sve sthāne nirbrūyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
sve sthāne nirucya kāmaṃ tata ūrdhvaṃ nirbrūyāditi śālīkiratro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ pañcaitāni sviṣṭakṛtsthānāni bhavantīti
teṣu sarveṣu nirbrūyāditi ||
athāpāhṛtāgnernaṣṭāraṇīkasya ceti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ kāmaṃ naṣṭeṣu vāpahṛteṣu vāgniṣu nādri yetāgnyādheyam
ādhānaprabhṛti yajamāna evāgnayo bhavanti
tasya prāṇo gārhapatyo'pāno'nvāhāryapacano vyāna āhavanīyaḥ
kāmamupāvarohya juhuyāditi ||
agnīnāṃ viharaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyādhānaprabhṛtyevaite'jasrāḥ syuriti śālīkiḥ ||
pātrāṇām̐ sādana iti ||
sūtram̐ śālikeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ kūrce vā tṛṇeṣu vā pātrāṇi sādayedapasavyaṃ dāruṇā dāru saṃlīyamānaṃ bhavatīti ||
dvayorhoma iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi pūrvā bhreṣaṃ nīyāduttarayā prāyaścittaṃ kurvītātha yadyuttarā bhreṣaṃ nīyādubhayaṃ bhreṣakṛtam̐ syādanyayā prāyaścittaṃ kurvītetyatro ha smāha śālīkiryatarā katarā cidbhreṣaṃ nīyādubhayaṃ bhreṣakṛtam̐ syādanyayaiva tataḥ prāyaścittaṃ kurvīteti 
abhijvalana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
gārhapatyādaṅgāreṇābhijvālya triḥ paryagni kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
vartma kurvannudagudvāsayatīti ||

traya ime lokā eṣveva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhatīti ||
unnayana iti ||
pūrṇānvānūco veti

saṃmarśa iti ||

sruggatameveti śālīkiḥ ||
atha jaghanena gārhapatyamupasādayatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyansayāgreṇātihāyeti śālīkiḥ ||
havana iti ||
svayaṃ vyavetya juhuyāditi baudhāyano yadyasya putro vāntevāsī vālaṃkarmīṇaḥ syātsa dakṣiṇata āsīno juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
āhutyorhoma iti ||
pūrvāpare juhuyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
praṣṭī iti śālīkiḥ ||
dvirupamṛjya dvirnimṛjediti baudhāyanaḥ
sakṛdupamṛjya dvirnimṛjediti śālīkiḥ ||
dviraṅgulyā prāśyodaṅparyāvṛtya prācīnadaṇḍayā srucā bhakṣayatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyodīcīnadaṇḍayā bhakṣayediti śālīkiḥ ||
nirṇijya srucaṃ niṣṭapyādbhiḥ pūrayitvodaguddiśatīti jaghanena gārhapatyamapo ninayatīdamahamagnau vaiśvānare'mṛtaṃ juhomi svāhetyakṣityāmakṣitāhutimiti veti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkiḥ ||
āgnipāvamānībhirupasthāna iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yathopasthitamāhavanīyamupasthāya tata āgnipāvamānībhirgārhapatyamupatiṣṭhetātha gāyatrībhiratha dvipadābhiratha śvo bhūte yathāyathamityatro ha smāha śālīkiryatprākcordhvaṃ cāgnipāvamānībhyastena saṃvatsaraṃ yathopasthitamāhavanīyamupasthāya tata āgnipāvamānībhirgārhapatyamupatiṣṭhetātha gāyatrībhiratha dvipadābhiratha śvo bhūte yathāyathamityevamaupamanyavo na cāsyāta ūrdhvamāgnipāvamānya āhavanīyamāgaccheyurna gārhapatyaṃ svādhyāyārthā evāsyāta ūrdhvam̐ syuriti
vyāhṛtībhirupasthāya bhartuṃ vaḥ śakeyaṃ śraddhā me mā vigādityeva brūyādityāñjīgaviḥ ||
āśiḥṣviti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ātmane prathamamāśāsītātha jātebhyo'tha tantava ity
atro ha smāha śālīkirjātebhyaḥ prathamamāśāsītāthātmane'tha tantava ityatro ha smāhaupamanyavo'jāteṣvevātmane ca tantave ceti
kāmamapi sāyaṃprātarāśāsītetyaupamanyavīputraḥ 
piṇḍapitṛyajñasya karaṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva prācīnāvītaṃ kurvīta
sa prācīnāvītyeva syādāhutīnām̐ homādāhutīrhoṣyanyajñopavītaṃ kurvīta
sa yajñopavītyeva syādā sakṛdācchinnasya staraṇāt
sakṛdācchinnam̐ stariṣyanprācīnāvītaṃ kurvīta
sa prācīnāvītyeva syādā prājāpatyāyai
yajñopavītyeva prājāpatyayarcā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhetetyatro ha smāha śālīkirādita eva prācīnāvītaṃ kurvīta
sa prācīnāvītyeva syādā prājāpatyāyai
yajñopavītyeva prājāpatyayarcodaṅṅeyāditi ||
tūṣṇīm̐ sakṛdutpūya sakṛtprokṣya sakṛddhaviṣkṛdrū paṃ kuryāditi baudhāyanaḥ
sakṛdevainānsuphalīkṛtānkṛtvā pavitravatyām̐ sthālyāmopya sthālīpākam̐ śrapayitvābhighāryodañcamudvāsayediti śālīkiḥ ||
āhutīnām̐ homa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
nātra madhyamāmāhutiṃ juhuyādmekṣaṇameva tṛtīyam̐ syāditi śālīkiḥ ||
sakṛdācchinnasya staraṇa iti ||
upaniṣkramyāgnyagārāddakṣiṇe pūrve'vāntaradeśe sakṛdācchinnam̐ stṛṇīyāddakṣiṇataścolmukamupanidadhyāditi baudhāyano'ntarevaitāṃ diśamiti śālīkirna cātrolmukamupanidadhyāditi ||
piṇḍānāṃ dāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ parastādevāmuto'rvāco'pasalaiḥ piṇḍāndadyāditi ||
āñjanābhyañjane manaso nihnava iti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
piṇḍānāmanupraharaṇṇiti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano'traivaite piṇḍāḥ pariśayīrannucchiṣṭā hyete bhavanti pitṛbhirbhakṣaṃkṛtā iti ||
atiśiṣṭasya prāśana iti ||
svayaṃ yajamānaḥ prāśnīyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
putrāya vāntevāsine vā dadyāditi śālīkiḥ
patnīṃ prāśayet
prajāsyaiṣā bhavatītyaupamanyavo'ṅgulyā yāvanmātramavaghrāyāthetaradagnāvanupraharedityaupamanyavīputro bhasmotkara udvāsya saṃpracchādayedityāñjīgavirapo'bhyavaharediti maudgalyaḥ 
āgrayaṇasya tantrasamāsa iti ||
nāsti tantrasamāsa ācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ saumyaṃ nirupyāthetarāṇi havīm̐ ṣi nirvapedevamasya carumukhāni havīm̐ ṣi bhavantītyatro ha smāhaupamanyavīputro'tipātādāvāpika eva saumyaḥ syādantareṇa vaiśvadevaṃ caikakapālaṃ ca nirvapedityatro ha smāhāñjīgavistrīṇyetāni havīm̐ ṣi bhavanti
traya ime lokā eṣveva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati

agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sannamāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vātipādayediti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pāthikṛtaṃ nirupya vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālamanunirvapedathātipannāṃ pratiyajedityatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ pāthikṛtaṃ nirupya vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam̐ samānatantramanunirvapenna cātipannāṃ pratiyajedityanyatareṇaiva sahātipannāṃ pratiyajedityaupamanyavo'tro ha smāhāñjīgavirvi vā etasya yajñaśchidyate yasya tantre pratate'nyattantraṃ pratāyate
ya evaiṣo'cyuta āgneyo'ṣṭākapālastameva paurṇamāsyāṃ vāmāvāsyāyāṃ vā pāthikṛtaṃ kuryānna cātipannāṃ pratiyajediti ||
agnaye vratapataye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedya āhitāgniḥ sannavratyamiva carediti ||
ādhānaprabhṛtyevaitaduktaṃ bhavatīti baudhāyano'nvāhiteṣu caivopasamāhiteṣu cāgniṣviti śālīkiḥ ||
agnaye rakṣoghne puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyam̐ rakṣām̐ si saceranniti ||
hutvāgnihotramiṣṭim̐ sam̐ sthāpayediti baudhāyanaḥ
sam̐ sthitāyāmiṣṭyāmagnihotraṃ juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
agnaye rudra vate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedabhicaranniti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavāsasaścartvijaḥ pracareyuriti
yājyāpuro'nuvākyābhyāmevaitaduktaṃ bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
agnaye surabhimate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyasya gāvo vā puruṣā vā pramīyeranyo vā bibhīyāditi ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prokṣaṇīṣu ca gandhānāvapeyurgandhavantaścartvijaḥ pracareyuriti
yājyāpuro'nuvākyābhyāmevaitaduktaṃ bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
agnaye kāmāya puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyaṃ kāmo nopanamediti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yā tatrāmnātā syāttāṃ cennirvapataḥ kāmo na samṛdhyetāthaivaṃ kuryādityeṣaiva sārvakāmikī syāditi śālīkiḥ
kāmekāma eṣā syādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
agnaye jyotiṣmate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyasyāgniruddhṛto'hute'gnihotra udvāyediti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano manthanamadhimanthanamupasamindhanamityetānmantrānnigadediti ||
vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapetputre jāta iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana utthitāyāṃ nirdaśāyāṃ vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapetsam̐ srāvasya ca kumāraṃ pralehayediti
jātameva viditveti śālīkirna ca sam̐ srāvasya kumāraṃ pralehayedityanantare parvaṇītyaupamanyavaḥ 
viparyastahaviṣīti ||
mārutaḥ prathamaṃ mantrakarma labheteti baudhāyano'vadānata iti śālīkiḥ
pradānata ityaupamanyavaścātuṣprāśyādityaupamanyavīputraḥ ||
vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedāyatanaṃ gatveti ||
yatraiva yatiṣyamāṇaḥ syāttadāyatanaṃ tadgatvā vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapediti baudhāyanaḥ
svasthāneṣvevāgniṣviti śālīkiḥ ||
yayā rajjvottamāṃ gāmājediti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyemāṃ te'sau prāhaiṣīdityeva brūyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
balabajānapīdhme saṃnahyediti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
balabajānāmapyatra barhiḥ saṃnaddhaṃ bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedabhicaranniti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
pratyabhicarantameva viditveti śālīkiḥ ||
sārasvatamājyamiti ||
mantraniruptametadghṛtam̐ syāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīkamiti śālīkiḥ
kālekāla evainaddhruvāvyādgṛhṇīyādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
adhvarakalpāyāmiti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana iḍāntaṃ prathamaṃ tantraṃ kuryādevaṃ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyena sahāvaśeṣaṃ vartayedityatro ha smāha śālīkirā praṇīnātprathamasya tantrasya pariśāyayedeva dvitīyameva tṛtīyaṃ tṛtīyena sahāvaśeṣaṃ vartayediti
sapūrṇapātraviṣṇukramā ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
yo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ syāttasmā etam̐ somāraudraṃ caruṃ tiṣyāpūrṇamāse nirvapediti ||
upavasathīye'hannirvapediti baudhāyano yajanīye'hanniti śālīkiḥ ||
ājyaṃ prokṣaṇamājyena mārjayanta iti ||
udakumbha ājyasruvaṃ pratyasyediti baudhāyanaḥ
prokṣaṇaṃ caiva mārjanaṃ cājyena kuryādathetaradadbhiḥ kuryāditi śālīkiryatkiṃ cādbhiḥ kāyam̐ rsyātsarvaṃ tadājyena kuryādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
yadi bibhīyādduścarmā bhaviṣyāmīti somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapediti ||
vijñāteṣu rūpeṣu nirvapediti baudhāyanaḥ
purastādeva śaṅkamāna iti śālīkiḥ ||
ardheṣviti ||
sam̐ sthitāyāmiṣṭyāmardhānabhyādadhyāditi baudhāyano'traiva pariśayīranniti śālīkiḥ 
viparyastahaviṣīti ||
mārutaḥ prathamaṃ mantrakarma labheteti baudhāyano'vadānata iti śālīkiḥ
pradānata ityaupamanyavaścātuṣprāśyādityaupamanyavīputraḥ ||
mārutībhyām̐ hotā yajatīti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva hotā maruta āvāhayedanuvācanato'dhvaryuriti
yājyāpuro'nuvākyābhyāmevaitaduktaṃ bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyaścaruṃ nirvapedbhūtikāma iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarvāḥ sapadāḥ sarvāḥ sasāvitrāḥ sarvāḥ samayūkhedhmā iti ||
padapām̐ sūnām̐ haraṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ samastenaivāsya mantreṇa padapām̐ sūnhṛtvottara vargya āvaped
atha tūṣṇīmurasyanuninayediti ||
śatam̐ suvarṇāni kṛṣṇalāni bhavantīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyopaśatānyevaitāni syuriti śālīkiḥ parihārayeccaiṣāmiti ||
catvāricatvāri kṛṣṇalānyavadyati caturavattasyāptyā iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yānyavattāni syurjuhuyādeva tānyatha yāni bhakṣārthāni syustadvyavagṛhītānyeva tāni syurathetarāṇi samāvaccho vibhajerannityatro ha smāha śālīkiryānyavattāni syurjuhuyādeva tānyatha yāni bhakṣārthāni syustadvyavagṛhītānyeva tāni syurathetarāṇi prāśitraharaṇa opya brahmaṇe parihārayediti ||
yaḥ pāpayakṣmagṛhītaḥ syāttasmā etamādityaṃ carumamāvāsyāyāṃ nirvapediti ||
upavasathīye'hannirvapediti baudhāyano yajanīye'hanniti śālīkiḥ ||
sāṃgrahaṇyai paridhiṣviti ||
aiṣṭikaiḥ paridhāya pauroḍāśikaiḥ paridadhyāditi baudhāyano'iṣṭikaireveti śālīkiḥ ||
āhutīnām̐ homa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyana audumbaraiḥ pātrairetā āhutīrjuhuyāddhutvā caitāni pātrāṇyatraivānupraharediti ||
ājyasyāvekṣaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yannavamaittannavanīyamabhavadityetairevājyamavekṣitamutpunuyāditi śālīkiḥ 
yāvato'śvānpratigṛhṇīyāttāvato vāruṇām̐ ścatuṣkapālānnirvapedekātiriktāniti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano vaiśvānareṇaikaṃ pratigṛhṇīyādevaṃ dvau
gaṇaṃ tu pratigṛhya kurvīta bahuṣu vāruṇānekātiriktānityatro ha smāha śālīkirvaiśvānareṇaikaṃ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu dvau
gaṇaṃ tu pratigṛhya kurvīta na tu dvayorbahuṣu vā vāruṇānekātiriktāniti ||
āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravatī syāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīketi śālīkiḥ ||
punaḥ samūhati samūhyāvadyatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyaitaireva mantraiḥ pratisamūhyāvadyediti śālīkiḥ ||
trayastrim̐ śatkapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
saṃdigdhapuroḍāśa evaiṣa syāditi śālīkiḥ ||
varṣāhūstambasyābhihoma iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yatraiva varṣāhūstambaḥ syāttadgacchediti śālīkiḥ ||
kṛṣṇājinasyāvadhavana iti ||
antarvedi tiṣṭhankṛṣṇājinamavadhunuyāditi baudhāyano bahirvedīti śālīkiḥ ||
añjaḥsavakārīryai karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
sam̐ sarge prāyaścittakaraṇa iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo yo nu khalvāhavanīyo'ta evaiṣa uddhṛto bhavati
grāmayoniranvāhāryapacanas
tatratatra nāsti prāyaścittampraśasto hi vṛthāgnisam̐ sarga iti ||
itīnnvā imā iṣṭayo vyākhyātāḥ 
abhikrāmaṃ juhotīti ||
kiyati nu khalvetaduktaṃ bhavatīti ||
pañca prayājā iti baudhāyano yatprākśālāyā iti śālīkiḥ ||
yadi paśoravadānaṃ naśyedājyasya pratyākhyāyamavadyediti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi paśoravadānaṃ naśyedyadyekaṃ yadi dve ājyasya pratyākhyāyamiṣṭvā tatkṛtvā punaryajetetyatro ha smāha śālīkiryadi paśoravadānaṃ naśyedyadyekaṃ yadi dve ājyasya pratyākhyāyamiṣṭvā tatkṛtvā kṛtameva manyetātha yadi bhūyo'thaivaṃ kuryāditi ||
sam̐ sava iti ||
yatra kvaca nāvyā vā nadī syādantareṇodayakṣmavatī vāsam̐ savastatreti baudhāyano yatra kvacana śabdā na sam̐ sṛjyerannasam̐ savastatreti śālīkiryatra kvacanāntareṇeyādasam̐ savastatretyaupamanyavaḥ
prasthayoreva janapadayorasam̐ savastatretyaupamanyavīputro
nāvidviṣāṇayoḥ sam̐ savo vidyata iti chāgaleyabrāhmaṇaṃ bhavatītyāñjīgaviḥ ||
abhibhūtīnām̐ homa iti ||
ādhvarā hutvā sāttrāyaṇikā juhuyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
sāttrāyaṇikā eveti śālīkiḥ ||
dīrṇapravṛtteṣviti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yābhyāmetadṛgbhyāṃ pūtabhṛdādhavanīyayorjuhuyāttābhyāṃ grahegrahe juhuyādatha tūṣṇīm̐ sam̐ srāvamavanayediti ||
nitye grahaṇe vaiṣṇavīmṛcamanuvartayatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
pṛṣadājya evaiṣānuvartayitavyā bhavatīti śālīkiḥ ||
sa ukthamukthaṃ vaiva pratigīryokthaśā ityāha savanam̐ savanaṃ veti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
pṛṣṭhyagrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yatra kvacaitānyahāni saṃgaccheyurgṛhṇīyādeva tatra pṛṣṭhyagrahāniti
saṃvatsara evaite dṛṣṭā bhavanti
saṃvatsara evaināngṛhṇīyādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
pṛṣṭhyagrahāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano'nusavanabhakṣeṇa caivainānbhakṣayennityena ceti
nityenaiveti śālīkiḥ ||
am̐ śūnāṃ pravṛm̐ haṇa iti ||
ekaikaśaḥ pravṛhediti baudhāyanaḥ
sarvānsaheti śālīkiḥ 
ādhavana iti ||
vyaticāramādhunuyāditi baudhāyano yathādhavitramiti śālīkirmekṣayedityaupamanyavaḥ ||
am̐ śorhoma iti ||
sūtraṃ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yābhyāmetadṛgbhyāmupaspṛśettābhyāmenaṃ juhuyādatha tūṣṇīmupaspṛśediti ||
pṛśnigrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
tena kakṣamupoṣatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyāpūpenaivāpyatra kakṣamupoṣediti śālīkiḥ ||
ṛṣabho goṣu jīryatīti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yamapyanyaṃ bahistantrātpaśumālabheta tatrāpyetāni kuryādupākaraṇīyayorvapāyāṃ devatāsviti ||
aṣṭāpadyai garbhasya vasāhoma iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
na garbhasya vasāhomaṃ juhuyāditi śālīkirna ca garbhasya vasāhomaṃ juhuyānneḍāṃ na sviṣṭakṛtamityaupamanyavaḥ 
ajavaśāyā upākaraṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
vāyavyayaivaināmupākuryāditi śālīkiratro ha smāha jyāyānkātyāyano yathāpyupākaraṇa upākaraṇaṃ nudata evamevāpyuttare mantrā nudyeranniti ||
yadālabdhāyāmabhro bhavatīti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadyahāntaśritā akṛṣṇā meghāḥ syuḥ sam̐ sthāpayedevātha cetkṛṣṇāḥ syurathaivaṃ kuryādityatro ha smāha śālīkiryadyaha nādityamantardadhyuḥ sam̐ sthāpayedevātha cedenamantardadhyurathaivaṃ kuryāditi
nālabdhāyāmasam̐ sthāpanaṃ vidyata iti gautamaḥ ||
jayeṣviti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
abhyātāneṣviti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīkeruttaro baudhāyanasyātro ha smāhaupamanyavo'bhyātānāñjayānrāṣṭrabhṛta iti sruvāhutīrevaitā juhuyādgaccheyuśca darśapūrṇamāsāvabhyātānāñjayānrāṣṭrabhṛta iti ||
śamyāparidhiṣviti ||
śamyaiva śamyāparidhīnkuryāditi baudhāyanaḥ
prākṛtā evaitāḥ syuriti śālīkiḥ ||
dviḥsvāhākāram̐ rāṣṭrabhṛto juhotīti ||

naiyagrodha audumbara āśvatthaḥ plākṣa itīdhmo bhavatīti ||

tāṃ dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyādyasyānnaṃ nādyāditi ||

yasyāhavanīye'nudvāte gārhapatya udvāyediti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ samastametamagnim̐ sate samupya dakṣiṇena vihāraṃ paryāhṛtya gārhapatyasyāyatanādbhasmodvāpya śakṛtpiṇḍena parilipya nyupyopasamādhāya jvalantamāhavanīyamuddhṛtyāhavanīyasyāyatanādbhasmodvāpya śakṛtpiṇḍena parilipya nyupyopasamādhāya samidvatyāhavanīye ṣaṭsruvāhutīrjuhuyādudbudhyasvāgne tvamagne saprathā asi mano jyotirjuṣatāṃ tantuṃ tanvannudu tyaṃ citramiti ||
atiriktasomeṣviti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
dhruve parihīṇe prāyaścittakaraṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prākcedavabhṛthācchandogabahvṛceṣu labherannabhyāvarttayeyu stutaśastrāṇi syustatkṛtvā punaryajetetyatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ prākcedavabhṛthācchandogabahvṛceṣu labherannabhyāvartayeyu stutaśastrāṇi syustatkṛtvā kṛtameva manyeteti ||
ahnāṃ grahaṇa iti ||

yadevānantaramahaḥ syāttasminmaitrāvaruṇāgrāngrahāngṛhṇīranniti śālīkiḥ ||
yūpe virūḍhe prāyaścittakaraṇa iti ||

yasya soma upadasyetsuvaṇim̐ rraṇyaṃ dvedhā vicchidyarjīṣe'nyadādhunuyājjuhuyādanyaditi ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
sahiraṇyā evāsyāta ūrdhvaṃ mukhyāścamasā hūyerannabhyunnīyeranniti śālīkiḥ ||
ādārasomeṣviti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyādārasomenaivāpyanyamāgamayeranniti śālīkiḥ ||
āśiḥṣviti ||
āśiṣo'nuvarteranniti baudhāyana etā evāśiṣaḥ syuriti śālīkiḥ 
athāto dvādaśāhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
cinvīta dvādaśāhe'gnimiti baudhāyano na cinvīteti śālīkiḥ ||
atigrāhyā iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano gṛhapatirevāraṇyoḥ samāropayedetadatigrāhyasya rūpaṃ bhavatītyatro ha smāha śālīkiḥ pṛthagevāraṇīṣu samāropayerangṛhapatereva prathamasya mathitvā jvalatsu jvalato'pi visṛjerannityetadatigrāhyasya rūpaṃ bhavatīti ||
saṃnivāpa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ saṃnivapsyanto'gnaye brahmaṇvate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapeyuragnaye kṣatravate'gnaye kṣatrabhṛta ityatro ha smāha śālīkiragnisaṃyojanī khalveṣeṣṭirbhavati
yatraivāgniṃ ceṣyamāṇaḥ syāttatraināṃ nirvapedityaprājāpatyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamanuvartayetetyaupamanyavaḥ ||
pavana iti ||
ekaikaśa evainānpavayitvaikaikaśa udānayeyuriti baudhāyanaḥ
sakṛdevainānpavayitvaikaikaśa udānayeyuriti śālīkiḥ
sakṛdevainānpavayitvā sarvānsahodānayeyurityaupamanyavaḥ ||
ārṣeyavaraṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano ye kecana samānagotrā avyavetā anyathāgotrāḥ syurekasyārṣeyaśca varaṇa eva teṣāṃ varaṇam̐ syādityatro ha smāha śālīkiryadi caiva vyavetā yadi cāvyavetāḥ samānagotrā ekasyārṣeyavaraṇa eva teṣāṃ varaṇam̐ syāditi ||
vratadhukṣviti ||
samātacya samāvaccho vibhajeranniti baudhāyanaḥ
pṛthagevaiṣāṃ vratadughaḥ syuriti śālīkiḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhyāmupasadyuttaravedim̐ saṃnivapantīti sūtramācāryayorapi vaikādaśyāmiti vidhiḥ ||
vasatīvarīṇāmabhigrahaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yadi sātiśeṣaḥ kalaśaḥ syāttūṣṇīmavanayedyadyu vai sarvaśa eva lepaḥ samavanītaḥ syādathaivaṃ kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
so'tra vaiva yajñasya punarālambhaṃ japati yajñāyajñīyasya vā stotre śaṃyuvāke veti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkiḥ ||
vivartayanti paridhīnanupraharati prastaramiti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyānupraharedevātra prastaraparidhīniti śālīkiḥ 
nimīlyādhvaryurupām̐ śu juhotīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyānanvīkṣamāṇa eva juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
śilpairupākaraṇa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayenopākuryādbarhirbhyāṃ ca śilpaiśceti
śilpaireveti śālīkiḥ ||
nyūṅkhana iti ||
virājāṃ vā pratipatsu nyūṅkhayati śastre veti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
nirmanthyasya mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravānsyāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ ||
dākṣiṇām̐ homa iti ||
sa ha smāha baudhāyano juhuyādevāhutīrjapetpratyayamantrānityatro ha smāha śālīkirjuhuyādevāhutīrna tu pratyayamantrāñjapediti
ye ke ca dakṣiṇāyuktā mantrāḥ syurnaivainānādri yetetyaupamanyavaḥ 
avivākya iti ||
avivākyametadaharbhavatīti baudhāyano vibrūyādeveti śālīkiḥ ||
ṛcāmuddharaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yathāprakṛtimevādhvaryuḥ kuryādchandogabahvṛcā eva pratikurvīranniti śālīkiḥ ||
sarpaṇa iti ||
kṛṣṇājināntaiḥ sarpanta uttaram̐ havirdhānamupaspṛśeyuriti baudhāyano nopaspṛśeyuriti śālīkiḥ ||
āgrayaṇāgreṣviti ||
vācaṃyamo'dhvaryuḥ pūrvāngrahasthāngṛhṇīyāditi baudhāyano visṛṣṭavāgiti śālīkiḥ ||
sa śukraṃ gṛhītvā dhārayati yāvaditarau grahau gṛhṇātīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yaṃyaṃ gṛhṇīyāttaṃtaṃ parimṛjya sādayediti śālīkiḥ ||
grahādhāneṣvanusaṃvrajyāyā iti ||
anusaṃvrajediti baudhāyano nānusaṃvrajediti śālīkiḥ ||
paśukalpeṣviti ||
sarve kalpā baudhāyanasyāindrā gnapaśūnyevāhīnarātrisattrāṇi bhavantīti śālīkiḥ ||
teṣāṃ yāni samahāvratāni tāni sāgnicityānyathetarāṇyauttaravedikāni syuriti baudhāyano'ikāhikastvevāgniriti śālīkiḥ ||
ākṣīyeṣviti ||
abhijidviṣuvānviśvajiddaśamamaharmahāvratamityetānyākṣīyanti bhavantīti baudhāyano
yānyanyāni pṛṣṭhyābhiplavebhya iti śālīkiryāni cānyāni pṛṣṭhyābhiplavebhyo daśamāccāhna ityaupamanyavaḥ
prāyaṇīyārambhaṇīyāvabhijidviṣuvānviśvajiddaśamamaharmahāvratamudayanīyo'tirātra ityetānyaṣṭāvākṣīyanti bhavantīti gautamaḥ ||
paśukalpeṣviti ||
sarve kalpā baudhāyanasyāikādaśinapaśūnyeva sāṃvatsarikāṇi sattrāṇi bhavantīti śālīkiḥ ||
vāṇaḥ śatatanturbhavatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
vīṇaivaiṣā tantrībhiḥ śatatamā syāditi śālīkiḥ ||
ahargaṇe māhāvratikānām̐ śilpānāṃ karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
ahargaṇe śikhānāmanupravapaṇa iti ||
anupravaperanniti baudhāyano nānupravaperanniti śālīkiḥ 
dvirātra iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yajanīye'hanpūrvamaharbhavatyuttarasminnuttramiti śālīkiḥ ||
tasminnunnato vehadvāmana iti bhavantīti ||
upaivaite nityāḥ sahasre syuriti baudhāyana eta eva sahasratamāḥ syuriti śālīkiḥ ||
dro ṇakalaśasyāvaghrāpaṇa iti ||
antaḥparidhyavaghrāpayediti baudhāyano bahiḥparidhīti śālīkiḥ ||
rūpāṇām̐ homa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyāśvamedhikānyapyatra rūpāṇi juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
udyatstomeṣviti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
aupasadānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravantaḥ syuriti baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīkā iti śālīkirāgneyā ekakapālāḥ sruvāhutyā cainānsaha sakṛjjuhuyādityaupamanyavaḥ ||
dvayīrgā upakalpayanta iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyājā apyatropakalpayīranniti śālīkiḥ ||
ulūkhalabudhno yūpo bhavatīti ||
sarvānkārānkuryāditi baudhāyanaḥ
prokṣyainamucchrayediti śālīkiḥ ||
prokṣyopāsya yūpaśakalamucchrayedityaupamanyavaḥ ||
pām̐ sūnāmanusam̐ haraṇa iti ||
dhiṣṇiyebhya audumbaryā avaṭāduparavebhya utkarāduttaravedyai pām̐ sūnanusam̐ harediti baudhāyano nānusam̐ harediti śālīkiḥ ||
atha yadi dīkṣopasatsu pratyayamācakṣīransaṃprakīryodavasānīyābhiriṣṭibhiriṣṭvottiṣṭheyuriti baudhāyana ekāham̐ sutvottiṣṭheyuriti śālīkirnāsam̐ sthāpya pṛṣṭhyam̐ ṣaḍahamuttiṣṭheyurityaupamanyavaḥ 
teṣāmutthāneṣviti ||
gaccheyurāvabhṛthāditi baudhāyano'psuṣomāntā iti śālīkirdhruvāntā ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
janakasaptarātro'tirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaha iti baudhāyanaḥ
pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho'tirātra iti śālīkiḥ ||
daśarātrāya dīkṣiṣyamāṇo daśahotāram̐ hutvā daśarātrāya dīkṣata iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
saptahotāram̐ hutvā daśahotāraṃ juhuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
iti nu brāhmaṇavān||
atha gobaladaśarātro'tirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho vājapeyo mahāvrataṃ cātirātraścāṣṭame'hni vājapeyaḥ ||
tatra devasuvām̐ haviṣāṃ karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkis
trayastrim̐ śasya paśupuroḍāśamanuvarterannityaupamanyavaḥ ||
vilupyamāne pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe śilpānāṃ karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
ekaṣaṣṭirātre vaiśvakarmaṇādityayorgrahaṇa iti ||
uttare trim̐ śadrā tre gṛhṇīyāditi baudhāyanaḥ
saṃvatsara evaitau dṛṣṭau bhavataḥ
saṃvatsara evainau gṛhṇīyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
audumbaram̐ ṣoḍaśipātramiti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
khādirameveti śālīkiḥ ||
atirātrapaśūnāmupākaraṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
sārasvatīmevopākuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
ṣoḍaśivatāṃ camasānāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti ||
vyaktānbhakṣayediti baudhāyana indra pītāniti śālīkiḥ ||
rātriparyāyeṣu mukhyānāṃ camasānāmabhimarśana iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyana indrā ya tvāpiśarvarāyetyeva mukhyaṃmukhyaṃ camasamabhimṛśediti ||
āśvinasya mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravānsyāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ ||
āśvinasya caryāyā iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ purastāttiroahniyānāṃ camasānāṃ caryāyā amutrāśvinena carediti ||
tiroahniyānāṃ camasānāṃ bhakṣaṇa iti ||
anuṣṭupchandasā bhakṣayediti baudhāyano jagatīcchandaseti śālīkiḥ ||
gudatṛtīyeṣviti ||
ekādaśadhā kṛtvopayaṣṭopayajediti baudhāyano'pacchedamiti śālīkiḥ
samastānyevainānyanuprahṛtya sarvairmantrairanumantrayetetyaupamanyavaḥ 
ekādaśinyai saṃpradāna iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyana ekādaśāgnīṣomīyā ekādaśa savanīyā ekādaśānubandhyā iti ||
upaśayasya mantrāmantra iti ||
labheta grāme nāraṇya iti baudhāyano labhetāraṇye na grāma iti śālīkirnaiva grāme nāraṇya ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
upaśayasyopāsana iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyātraivottarata upāsyediti śālīkiḥ ||
pātnīvatasya parilekhana iti ||
śālāmukhīyam̐ śaṅkumabhiparilikhediti baudhāyana uttarata ekādaśinyai pātnīvataṃ minuyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
tvāṣṭrasya mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravānsyāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ ||
tvāṣṭrasyotsarga iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano'bhiparyagnikṛtamenamantareṇa cātvālotkarāvudaṅṅupaniṣkramayyādbhirabhyukṣya yajamānasyājāsvapisṛjediti ||
tvāṣṭrasya caryāyā iti ||
upām̐ śu carediti baudhāyana uccairiti śālīkiḥ ||
punaścitāviti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yamapyagniṃ cinvāno'pajānīyāttasminnupari punaścitiṃ cinuyāduttarataśca yūpādyūpaṃ minuyāditi ||
kauṇḍapāyinīyāsviṣṭiṣviti ||
agnyanvādhānapratipatkā iḍāntāḥ saṃtiṣṭheranniti baudhāyana ājyabhāgapratipatkā iḍāntā iti śālīkiḥ
sapūrṇapātraviṣṇukramā ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
piṇḍapitṛyajñasya dāna iti ||
aharahardadyāditi baudhāyana ādita antataśca māsasyeti śālīkiḥ 
hotṛṇāṃ vyākhyāna iti ||
sagrahānṛtesvāhākārānityekam
ṛtegrahānantaḥsvāhākārānityekaṃ sarvānityekaṃ ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottarau śālīkeḥ ||
sa paurṇamāsīṣupaurṇamāsīṣu juhvaddvādaśa kṛtvaḥ saṃvatsare juhuyādityetadekam
amāvāsyāpaurṇamāsīṣvityetadekaṃ sarvāsvityetadekam||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottarau śālīkeḥ ||
trayastrim̐ śaccitāviti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano'gnigrahaṇam̐ svayaṃcitim̐ śvetakṛṣṇayorabhimarśanamadhidra vaṇamavadra vaṇamiti sarvamevaitatkarmāvṛtā kuryāditi ||
aharahaścitāviti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano'gnigrahaṇam̐ svayaṃcitim̐ śvetakṛṣṇayorabhimarśanamadhidra vaṇamavadra vaṇamiti sarvamevaitatkarmāvṛtā kuryāditi ||
rathacakracitau purīṣasyopadhāna iti ||
purīṣasyāntānkuryāditi baudhāyana iṣṭakāsveva purīṣasyāntaṃ gacchediti śālīkiḥ 
rohite carmaṇīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasyāpyarohitam̐ syāditi śālīkiḥ ||
ubhayanītasya karaṇa iti ||
ubhe ṛcau dvirabhyāvartayediti baudhāyanaḥ
sakṛdeva bruvandvirbrūyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
prāṅsomaḥ pratyaṅsomaḥ
pratyaṅsomaḥ prāṅsoma iti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
sautrāmaṇikāyai surāyai saṃdhāna iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavo yatraiva surā syāttata evāhārayediti ||
surāgrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
payograhānapyatra gṛhṇīyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
tāñjaghanena srugdaṇḍānprāco vodīco vāyātayatīti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
surāsomasya saṃcara iti ||
dakṣiṇena hṛtvottareṇāvanayediti baudhāyana uttareṇa hṛtvā dakṣiṇenāvanayediti baudhāyaniryata evainam̐ harettata evainamavanayedityaupamanyavaḥ ||
pāvamānībhirupasthāna iti ||
pāvamānībhirupasthāya pitṛṇāṃ yājyānuvākyābhirupatiṣṭheranniti baudhāyanaḥ
pitṛṇāmeva yājyānuvākyābhirna pāvamānībhiriti śālīkiḥ ||
avabhṛtha iti ||
sūtramācāryayoratro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ śūlaiśca māsareṇa cāvabhṛthamaveyāditi ||
ākhyātamudakāntasya pratyasanam||
ākhyātamāplavanam||
ākhyātam̐ samidhāṃ karaṇaṃ ||
vaimṛdhasyānunirvapaṇa iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
nāniṣṭvā prathamasomenānunirvapediti śālīkiḥ 
paurṇamāsīmeva yajeta bhrātṛvyavānnāmāvāsyāmiti ||
ubhayatra paurṇamāsahavirbhiryajeteti baudhāyano nāmāvāsyāyāṃ kiṃcana yajñarūpaṃ kuryāditi śālīkiḥ
piṇḍapitṛyajñena caredityaupamanyavaḥ ||
sākaṃprasthāyīyena yajeta paśukāma iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ srugbhyāmeva puroḍāśaṃ juhuyāccamasena sāṃnāyyamiti ||
nāgataśrīrmahendraṃ yajeta
trayo vai gataśriyaḥ śuśuruvāngrāmaṇī rājanyas
teṣāṃ māhendro devateti ||
sa yo'nya etebhyo mahendra miyakṣeta sa saṃvatsaramindra miṣṭvā mahendre jyāṃ labheteti baudhāyano'ta evāpi saṃvatsaramindra miṣṭvā mahendre jyāṃ labheteti śālīkiḥ ||
saṃvatsaramindraṃ yajeta
saṃvatsaram̐ hi vrataṃ nātīti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yasyāmamāvāsyāyāmādita indraṃ yaṣṭuṃ prakrāmetsaṃvatsare paryavete tasyāṃ mahendraṃ yajeta
so'ta ūrdhvaṃ mahendra yājyeva syādityatro ha smāhaupamanyavo'bhyārūḍhaḥ khalvasyaiva saṃvatsaro bhavati yasyāmamāvāsyāyāmādita indraṃ yaṣṭuṃ prakrāmetsaṃvatsare paryavete yā tataḥ pūrvāmāvāsyā syāttasyāṃ mahendraṃ yajeta
so'ta ūrdhvaṃ mahendra yājyeva syāditi ||
dākṣāyaṇayajñena suvargakāmo yajeta
pūrṇamāse saṃnayenmaitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayāmāvāsyāyāṃ yajeteti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
vaimṛdhamapyatrānunirvapediti śālīkiḥ ||
sāṃnāyyasya bhakṣaṇa iti ||
sūtram̐ śālīkeratro ha smāha baudhāyano yajamāna evaitamardhamāsamanunidhāya sāṃnāyyaṃ bhakṣayediti ||
āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti ||
mantravatī syāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīketi śālīkeḥ ||
iḍādadhe catuñcakra upām̐ śuyājasya karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ 
bṛhaspatisave dākṣiṇānāṃ homa iti ||
anusavanaṃ dākṣiṇāni juhuyāditi baudhāyano mādhyaṃdina eva savane dākṣiṇāni juhuyāddadāmītyevetarāyoḥ savanayorbrūyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
hiraṇyena ghṛtamutpunātīti ||
mantraniruptametadghṛtam̐ syāditi baudhāyanas
tūṣṇīkamiti śālīkiḥ ||
anuddhate vedyai dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya bṛhata stotraṃ pratyabhiṣiñcatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
kṛṣṇājinamapyatrāstṛtyābhiṣiñcediti śālīkiḥ ||
māṣaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kamaṇḍalumiti ||
sauvarṇaḥ sauvarṇairmāṣaiḥ pūrṇaḥ syāditi baudhāyano mārttika eva dhānyamāṣairiti śālīkiḥ ||
saptadaśa mārutīḥ pṛśnīrvatsatarīrālabhata iti ||
pṛthagevāsāṃ manotāḥ syuḥ pṛthakpaśupuroḍāśa iti baudhāyanaḥ
pṛthagevasāṃ manotāḥ syurekaḥ paśupuroḍāśa iti śālīkirekaivāsāṃ manotā syādekaḥ paśupuroḍāśa ityaupamanyavaḥ ||
agniṣṭutīndra stutīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yathāprakṛtimevādhvaryuḥ kuryāchandogabahvṛcā eva prativikurvīranniti śālīkiḥ ||
atiriktastotreṣviti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
dhanuṣaḥ pradāna iti ||
pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīkeruttaro baudhāyanasya ||
ekāhānāmanta iti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
mṛtyusavānta iti śālīkiḥ ||
nidadhatyasmā etaddhavirucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanamiti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
nātra havirucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanaṃ nidadhyāditi śālīkiḥ ||
athāsyām̐ sadyaskriyāmanukriyāṃ parikriyāmatikriyāṃ pravargyasya karaṇa iti ||
kuryāditi baudhāyano na kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
śavānaso'dhiṣavaṇe phalake puruṣāsthasya vṛṣaṇāviti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
śavānaso'pyatrāraṇī kuryāditi śālīkiḥ ||
sa yaṃ kaṃ ca grahaṃ gṛhṇātyevamevainaṃ gṛhṇāti
yadu kiṃ ca pātram̐ sādayatyevainatsādayatīti ||
sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
yaṃyaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāttaṃtaṃ parimṛjya sādayediti śālīkiḥ ||
śvetamaśvaṃ dadāti
śvetāṃ vaḍabāṃ dadātyaśvamasitaṃ dadāti
garbhiṇīṃ vaḍabāṃ lalāmīṃ dadātyanaḍucchataṃ dadāti
trayastrim̐ śataṃ niṣkāndadāti
somacamasaṃ dadāti
hiraṇmayaṃ camasaṃ dadāti
rāśikṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti
marāyakṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ dadātīti ||
etāni ca nityāni ca dadyāditi baudhāyana etānyeveti śālīkiḥ 
athātaḥ sarvatomukhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
cinvīta sarvatomukhe'gnimiti baudhāyano na cinvīteti śālīkiratro ha smāha maudgalyaḥ pūrvasminnevāgnicaya itareṣu sāvitrāḥ syurityetadapi na kuryādityāñjīgaviḥ ||

kasminnu khalvenatkāle samutthāpayediti

śatam̐ rājāna ugrā iti

pautudra vāvabhito bhavataḥ puṇyasya gandhasyāvaruddhyā iti

caturutrarīya eṣa catuṣṭomo bhavati

kathamu khalvetānanuvākāñjuhuyāditi
yathāprakṛtyastathānantarāyam̐ hotavyāścaturvim̐śatim̐ raśanā ādāya yūpānabhyāyanti catasraścatasra itare parikarmiṇa iti
kathametāsu niyuñjyādityaśvastūparo gomṛga iti te trayaḥsamānaraśanā rarāṭyeṣu tisraḥ
paryaṅgyeṣu pañcāgnaye'nīkavate rohitāñjiranaḍvānityeteṣvaṣṭau
somāya svarājñe'novāhāvanaḍvāhavityeteṣu saptāthaiteṣāṃ trayastrayaḥ samānaraśanārmukhyasyaivaiṣāṃ caturthī bhavati
samānaṃ karmā paryagnikaraṇāt
paryagnikṛtānāmeteṣāṃ paśūnāmūnavim̐ śatirutsṛjyanta ekacatvārim̐ śatamatiśiṣyante

prāsaṅgyāvevaitāvuktau bhavato'thaitasmiñchalmaliśarca āśupiṣṭāni saṃyutyety

pṛthakpratiprasthātāro'vadyanti

athāparam
āgneyāḥ prathamā aindrā dvitīyā vaiśvadevāstṛtīyā maitrāvaruṇāścaturthā bārhaspatyāḥ pañcamāḥ sāvitrāḥ ṣaṣṭhāḥ saṃvatsarāya nivakṣasa iti prājāpatyāḥ 
athāyaṃ dvādaśāha ubhayavidho bhavatyahīno vā sattraṃ vā
sa yadyu haiko dīkṣate'hīno bhavatyatha yadi bahavaḥ sattraṃ yadi caivāhīno yadi ca sattramubhayathaivobhayato'tirātro bhavatyanyatarato'tirātrā hyahīnā bhavantyubhayato'tirātrāṇi sattrāṇyādeśādevobhayato'tirātro'hīno bhavatyādeśāttu sattramanatirātraṃ yathaitadagniṣṭomāyanam̐ sārasvatamayanaṃ viśvasṛjāmayanamiti
kathamu khalveṣām̐ saṃnivāpaḥ syāditi
sāvitrebhyaḥ prathamam̐ saṃnivaperan
hutvā sāvitrāṇi visamārohyāgnihotrāṇi juhuyuratha vāyavyāya paśave saṃnivaperan
vāyavyeneṣṭvā visamārohyaivāgnihotrāṇi juhuyuratha yadi dīkṣaṇīyāyai saṃnivaperam̐ steṣāṃ tatsaṃnyuptānyeva syurvyudavasānīyāddvyadavasāyaiva prativeśā yajñapucchāni kurvīran
kathamu khalu saṃdīkṣitā viṣṇukramānkrameranniti
mahāpāśābhiparītā vā kramerannapi vā pāśānabhisaṃdhitvābhikramaḥ syādathāha kramasvāthāha kramasvety
atigurustathā kalpaḥ syādyatho etatsūtraṃ bhavati ṣaṣṭhyāmupasadyuttaravedim̐ saṃnivapantyapi vaikādaśyāmityanagnicaya evaitadupapadyate na sāgnicaye
kathamu khalveṣāmahīnasaṃtatirbhavatīti
vasatīvarīṇāmabhigrahaṇenādhvaryuḥ saṃtanotīdhmābarhiṣorupakalpanena ca payasāṃ viśāsanena ca vāco yamyena brahmātipraiṣeṇa hotā punarabhyāsena ca subrahmaṇyayodgātā yajñasya punarālambhena yajamānaḥ
pracaranta evaitaddhruvājyam̐ samādadate'themāni savanāni barhīm̐ ṣi saṃcinuyus
teṣāṃ mahārātra utthāyāgnīdhra ājyāni gṛhṇanto jvalayeranniti 
kathamu khalu divā prātaranuvākasyāhna upakramo bhavatīti
tatpatnīsaṃyājāntaṃ vā hṛdayaśūlāntaṃ vāhaḥ kṛtvā samupanahya rājānaṃ kāle vasatīvarīrabhigṛhyāhīnasaṃtatiṃ kṛtvā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya dro ṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāyāgnīdhraṃ drutvā samidddhārā yanty
āhṛtya samidha āhavanīya upasādayanti
parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣvāhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyām̐ saveśanīyāḥ samidho'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya payām̐ si viśiṣyāgnidhraṃ drutvāgnīdhre saṃveśanarūpāṇi kṛtvā prātaḥkarmaṇā pratipadyate
prasiddhena mahārātrikeṇa
siddhamata ūrdhvam
upastambhanaṃ vā etadyajñasya yadatigrāhyāścakre pṛṣṭhānīti
trivṛccaikavim̐ śaśca cakre āgneya upastambhanampañcadaśaśca triṇavaśca cakre aindra upastambhanam̐ saptadaśaśca trayastrim̐ śaśca cakre saurya upastambhanaṃ yatho etadbaudhāyanasya kalpaṃ vedayante nirmanthyo mantravānbhavatītyādhvaryavā evātra mantrā āvartante nāgnimanthanīyāḥ
svayamṛtuyājamevaitadaharbhavati naitadaharanyonyasyartuyājaṃ yajatīti 
āśrāvyādhvaryuranyasmai grahaṃ pradāyaitenaiva yathetametya jaghanena havirdhāne upaviśyartusaṃpraiṣamuktvopotthāya hutvā vyavanīya pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya yatrāyākṣīttatprāṅāsīno hotṛbhakṣaṃ bhakṣayetpratyaṅṅāsīno'dhvaryubhakṣampārucchepīrhotā śam̐ sati vālakhilyā maitrāvaruṇo viharati vṛṣākapiṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐ sī śam̐ satyevayāmarutamacchāvākaḥ
kiṃkarmā tarhyadhvaryurbhavatīti pratyāgṛṇātītyeva brūyādyā etā adhvaryuranuṣṭubha uddhṛtyāharati tāścatasro gāyatryastāstisro'nuṣṭubhaḥ
soma rājannehyavarohetyetasyai gāyatryai padamātreṇa rājānamupāvaharet
kathamu khalu daśamamaharbhaktyā sarvacaturvim̐śaṃ ca bhavati triṣṭomaṃ cānyatra tūṣṇīm̐ stomāditi
caturvim̐śo bahiṣpavamānaḥ pañcadaśaṃ brahmasāma trayastrim̐ śamagniṣṭomasāma
tāsāmu ha navāgacchanti
tāścaturvim̐śatiḥ saṃpadyanta etadevāpi daśamamaharbhaktyā sarvacaturvim̐śaṃ ca bhavati triṣṭomaṃ cānyatra tūṣṇīm̐ stomādityupasṛjanmātre vatsaṃ dhārayandharuṇo dhayanniti
kiṃdevatyā u khalviyamāhutirbhavatīti
prājāpatyetyeva brūyāditi 
athemaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ grahāgraireva prativyūhāmas
athemaṃ tasya navāhāni prativyūhaṃ gacchanti yānyanyāni prāyaṇīyodayanīyābhyāṃ daśamāccāhno'tha chandomās
tatṣaḍeva
svasthāno hi prathamastrirātro gāyatrīprātaḥsavane prathame trirātre'ṣṭau kṛtvo'gre prathamamupām̐ śvabhiṣavamabhiṣuṇuyādekādaśa kṛtvo dvitīyaṃ dvādaśa kṛtvastṛtīyammahām̐ indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā ityetayā triṣṭubhā māhendraṃ gṛhṇīyādadabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvamityetayā jagatyā sāvitram
aṣṭākapālānprātaḥsavanīyānkuryādekādaśakapālānmādhyaṃdinīyān
dvādaśakapālām̐ stṛtīyasavanīyān
vasumadgaṇena gāyatracchandasā prātaḥsavanīyānbhakṣayedrudra vadgaṇena triṣṭupchandasā mādhyaṃdinīyān
ādityavadgaṇena jagatīcchandasā tṛtīyasavanīyānity
atha jagatīprātaḥsavane dvitīye trirātre dvādaśa kṛtvo'gre prathamamupām̐ śvabhiṣavamabhiṣuṇyādaṣṭau kṛtvo dvitīyam
ekādaśa kṛtvastṛtīyammahām̐ indro ya ojasetyetayā gāyatryā māhendraṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyādvāmamadya savitarityetayā triṣṭubhā sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālānprātaḥsavanīyānkuryādaṣṭākapālānmādhyaṃdinīyān
ekādaśakapālām̐ stṛtīyasavanīyān
ādityavadgaṇena jagatīcchandasā prātaḥsavanīyānbhakṣayedvasumadgaṇena gāyatracchandasā mādhyaṃdinīyān
rudra vadgaṇena triṣṭupchandasā tṛtīyasavanīyānityatha triṣṭupprātaḥsavane tṛtīye trirātra ekādaśa kṛtvo'gre prathamamupām̐ śvabhiṣavamabhiṣuṇuyāddvādaśa kṛtvo dvitīyamaṣṭau kṛtvastṛtīyammahām̐ indro ya ojasetyetāṃ gāyatrīṃ trirabhyāvartayedanupayāmāṃ sā jagatī saṃpadyate
tayā māhendraṃ gṛhṇīyādhiraṇyapāṇimūtaya ityetayā gāyatryā sāvitram
ekādaśakapālānprātaḥsavanīyānkuryāddvādaśakapālānmādhyaṃdinīyān
aṣṭākapālām̐ stṛtīyasavanīyān
rudra vadgaṇena triṣṭupchandasā prātaḥsavanīyānbhakṣayedādityavadgaṇena jagatīcchandasā mādhyaṃdinīyān
vasumadgaṇena gāyatracchandasā tṛtīyasavanīyāniti 
athāyaṃ vaiṣuvato labheta māsagaṇānāmityeka āhuḥ saptadaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado vaiṣuvataṃ trim̐ śattamaṃ kathamu khalu goāyubhyām̐ stomā bhavantīti
gornu khalu pañcadaśo bahiṣpavamānastivṛntyājyāni sarvasaptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanam̐ sarvaikavim̐ śaṃ tṛtīyasvanam̐ sokthyam
athāyostrivṛdbahiṣpavamānaḥ pañcadaśānyājyāni sarvasaptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanam̐ sarvaikavim̐ śaṃ tṛtīyasavanam̐ sokthyam
athemau viśvajidabhijitāvagniṣṭomau sattragatau bhavataḥ
ke nu khalvetayo stomā bhavantītyabhi jinnu khalu tryudayaścaturāvṛtto'tha viśvajiccaturudayastryāvṛttaḥ
kathamu khalvekavim̐ śatigarbho bhavatītyabhijitamupetya pṛṣṭhyam̐ ṣaḍahamupeyuratha trīnparaḥsāmno'tha vaiṣuvatamatha trīnpratyaksāmno'thāvṛttaṃ pṛṣṭhyam̐ ṣaḍahamatha viśvajitaṃ kathamu khalu goāyuṣī vihṛte jānīyāditi
purastādabhijito gāmupeyātsvasthāna evāyurbhavatīti
kiyanto nu khalu gavāmayane'gniṣṭomā bhavantīti
jyotiragniṣṭomastrivṛdagniṣṭomo viśvajidabhijitāvagniṣṭomau vaiṣuvataṃ daśamamaharmahāvratamiti sapteti ha vā idaṃ gavāmayanaṃ prajñātastomaṃ bruvate
tasya hottaraṃ pakṣa āvṛttaṃ bhavati yadanyadgoāyubhyāṃ ca daśarātrācca
tryanīkānatrāvṛttāngrahāngṛhṇīyāt 
athemā dvātrim̐ śatamekādaśinyo gavāmayane
teṣāṃ pūrvasminpakṣasi ṣoḍaśa niṣṭhīyante saptadaśa ekādaśinyai bārhaspatyo vaiṣuvate savanīyaḥ saṃpadyate
tasya navāhānyapaśukānyatiricyanta iti
katamāni khalvimānyahāni bhavantīti
pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasyottarāṇi trīṇi trayaśchandomā daśamamaharmahāvratamudayanīyo'tirātra ityabhiplavāścākṣīyanti ca tadaṅgirasāmayanamiti
pṛṣṭhyānāmatra sthāne'bhiplavāneva dadhāti
pṛṣṭhyāścākṣīyanti ca tadādityānāmayanamityabhiplavānāmatra sthāne pṛṣṭhyāneva dadhātyagniṣṭomāścākṣīyanti ca tatprajāpaterayanamityubhayeṣāmatra pṛṣṭhyābhiplavānām̐ sthāne'gniṣṭomāneva dadhāty
āghāṭībhiḥ piñcholābhiḥ karkarīkābhirityāghāṭyo'ha koloṣṭhā bhavanti
piñcholā u ha vīṇākāṇabhraśā vīṇā u karkarīkās
taṃ kāla eva śastryātṛṇattītyātṛndyādityevedamuktaṃ bhavati 
atha vai bhavati
brahmavādino vadanti sa tvai yajeta yo'gniṣṭomena yajamāno'tha sarvastomena yajeteti
catvāri pañcadaśānyājyāni
tau dvau trim̐ śadvargau
tayoritarasmim̐ strim̐ śadvarge tisra upāsyati
tau dvau triṇavatrayastrim̐ śau
gāyatraṃ pūrve'hansāma bhavati traiṣṭubhamuttara iti hoturājyametāni saṃpādayedevamevottare'hni hoturevājye
athāsyaiṣā sahasratamyanyataenī kaṇḍūkṛtopakḷptā bhavatīti
sam̐ sevitetyevedamuktaṃ bhavati

saṃgrāmaṃ jitvā rājanya enāṃ dadyāt
kathamu khalu gargatrirātreṇartumukheṣu vihṛtena yajetetyāṣāḍhe vā śrāvaṇe vā pakṣe'gniṣṭomena vā yajeta
tatpatnīsaṃyājāntaṃ vā hṛdayaśūlāntaṃ vāhaḥ kṛtvā samupanahya rājānaṃ kāle vasatīvarīrabhigṛhyāhīnasaṃtatiṃ kṛtvā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya dro ṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāyāgnīdhraṃ drutvā samiddhārā yantyāhṛtya samidha āhavanīya upasādayanti
parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣvāhūtāyām̐ saubrahmaṇyāyām̐ saṃveśanīyāḥ samidho'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyāviśiṣya payām̐ syupavasantyatha śvo bhūte savaneṣṭyā yajeta
tata stambayajurharati
sa evamevāharaharvasatīvarīḥ pariharamāṇaścaturo māsaḥ savaneṣṭhyā yajate
nāgnihotraṃ juhoti na darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate'tha caturṣu māseṣu paryaveteṣu parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣvāhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyāmaharahaḥ saṃveśanīyāḥ samidho'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya payām̐ si viśiṣyopavasanti 
atha śvo bhūta ukthyena yajate
tattathaiva patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ vā hṛdayaśūlāntaṃ vāhaḥ kṛtvā samupanahya rājānaṃ kāle vasatīvarīrabhigṛhyāhīnasaṃtatiṃ kṛtvā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya dro ṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāyāgnīdhraṃ drutvā samiddhārā yantyāhṛtya samidha āhavanīya upasādayanti
parihṛtāsu vastīvarīṣvāhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyām̐ saṃveśanīyāḥ samidho'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyāviśiṣya payām̐ syupavasantyatha śvo bhūte savaneṣṭyā yajate
tatra tathaiva na stambayajurharati
sa evamevāharaharvasīvarīḥ pariharamāṇo'parām̐ ścaturo māsaḥ savaneṣṭyā yajate
naivāgnihotraṃ juhoti na darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate'tha caturṣu māseṣu paryaveteṣu parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣvāhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyāmaharahaḥ saṃveśanīyāḥ samidho'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya payām̐ si viśiṣyopavasantyatha śvo bhūte'tirātreṇa yajate sayajñapucchenāthaitām̐ sahasratamīṃ prācīṃ vodīcīṃ vāvartayam̐ stayā vihāraṃ cātmānaṃ ca na vyaveyāditi 
kiṃdakṣiṇā u khalvahīnā bhavantītyahargaṇo'hargaṇaḥ sahasradakṣiṇaḥ syādityetadekam
ekaikamahaḥ sahasradakṣiṇam̐ syādityetadekaṃ dvādaśaśatadakṣiṇam̐ syādityetadekaṃ yathāśraddhadakṣiṇam̐ syādityetadaparamādeśādevaitasminnatirātre sahasramanuvihitaṃ dadāti
dvirātraprabhṛtayo'hīnā bhavantyaikādaśarātrādathemānyahīnābhiparītāni sattrāṇi bhavanti yathaitatsaṃvatsaragarbha ekādaśarātra ubhayavidho hi bharatadvādaśāho dvādaśāgniṣṭomā rathaṃtarasāmānaḥ
sa ha bharatadvādaśāho'thodyatstomeṣu trivṛtprathamamahaḥ syātpañcadaśaṃ dvitīyam̐ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyamekavim̐ śaṃ caturthamitīnnvekam
athāparastrivṛtprathamasyāhnaḥ prātaḥsavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanam̐ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam
atha dvitīyasyāhnaḥ pañcadaśaṃ prātaḥsavanam̐ saptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanamekavim̐ śaṃ tṛtīyasavanam
atha tṛtīyasyāhnaḥ saptadaśaṃ prātaḥsavanamekavim̐ śaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanaṃ triṇavaṃ tṛtīyasavanam
atha caturthasyāhna ekavim̐ śaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanaṃ trayastrim̐ śaṃ tṛtīyasavanam 
athema aupasadāḥ puroḍāśāḥ śūrpādānaprabhṛtaya āpyāntāḥ

taṃ brahmaṇaḥ santaṃ paryupaviśya bhakṣayanti yadṛtaṃ manyante tena brāhmaṇambrāhmaṇo vai varṇānām̐ śreṣṭho'gnirdevānāmityetena vā bhakṣayedapi vā vyāhṛtībhiścatuṣṭoma eṣa bhavatīti caturuttarīya eṣa diśāṃ catuṣṭomo bhavaty

athāto mantragaṇāmnātāni prāyaścittāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ
sarvatropariṣṭānmantrakṛtaṃ yadyadhastānnipatedbrahma pratiṣṭhā manasa ityetayā pratiṣṭhāpyaitayaiva sruvāhutiṃ juhuyādhutvā vā pratiṣṭhāpayeddhutvānantaraṃ karma kuryādevamanyeṣvapyatikrāntaṃ karma nādri yeta yadyarthaluptaṃ bhavati

sarvatra praṇītānāṃ praṇīyamānānāṃ praṇītānāṃ vā yadi vipruṣo vipateyuḥ sravedvā camasa āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiradbhiḥ pūrayitvā tataṃ ma āpastadu tāyate punarityetayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt

sarvatra vitate yajñakarmaṇi 
yadi purā prajājebhyo bahiḥparidhyaṅgārā abhiparyāvarteranbrāhmaṇoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvemaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmītyetayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt
sarvatra vitate yajñakarmaṇi yadi yajñabhreṣa āgacchediṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍaniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhetyetairaṣṭābhiḥ sruvāhutīrjuhuyāt
sarvatra vitate yajñakarmaṇi yadi janyaṃ bhayamāgacchedyata indra bhayāmahe svastidā viśaspatirityetābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyādabhaye vā punaryajeta
sarvatropām̐ śuprabhṛti vāca sthānānām̐ svarākṣarapadavṛttabhreṣeṣvābhirgīrbhiryadato na ūnamityetayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt

tathā yājyāpuro'nuvākyāsvanyathānyatprāyaścittaṃ bhavedathāśvamedhasyānnahomeṣvāraṇyānāṃ paśūnām̐ sruvāhutyā ūnātiriktapunaruktavyāghāteṣu mindāhutī juhuyāt

devebhyo madhumattamam̐ svāheti mindāhutī vyāhṛtīśca hutvopākuryādatha yadi prātaranuvāke śasyamāna ādityo'bhyudiyādudvayaṃ tamasasparyudu tyaṃ citramityetābhiḥ sruvāhutīrjuhuyādatha yadi somo nāviḥ syānnavonavo bhavati jāyamāno yamādityā am̐ śumāpyāyayantītyetābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyādyadi sūryācandra masorgrahaṇaṃ vidyata etadeva  
atha yadi grahāngrahīṣyamāṇo bhāginīṃ devatāmagṛhītvā yonyāṃ gṛhṇīyāttathāmuṣmai svāheti tadānīmeva sarvaṃ juhuyādbhāginīṃ punargṛhītvā mindāhutī juhuyādapi vā grahāṇāmekena juhuyātsarvānvācaspate vidhe nāmannityevamādīngrahānhotrakāṇāṃ graheṣu vā camaseṣu vā havirdoṣoktadoṣo bhavet
tathāpo'bhyavahṛtya tatprāyaścittam̐ hutvā tathā punargṛhītvā juhuyāccamaseṣu punarunnīya juhuyāddhutvā vā tasminhiraṇyamantardhāyāpa ānīya bhakṣayet

indra jyeṣṭhebhyo varuṇarājabhyo'gnihotṛbhyo devebhyaḥ svāheti hutvāta ūrdhvaṃ paitṛmedhikaṃ karma pratipadyetābhaye vā punaryajeta

prakṣālitapādapāṇirapa ācamya prāṅmukha upaviśyāgnihotrayajuṣā yāvanmātraṃ vratayitvā tūṣṇīṃ bhūyo vratayetprajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyannityevamevopāsītā śrīravimokṣaṇāt

ukhyaścedudvāyedapsu bhasma praveśyokhām̐ śakṛtpiṇḍena parilipya punarevaināṃ pravṛjya paridāyāhutiṣāhaṃ kṛtvāthainām̐ sruvāhutibhirabhijuhoti suvarṇa gharmaḥ svāhā suvarṇārkaḥ svāhā suvarna śukraḥ svāhā suvarṇa jyotiḥ svāhā suvarṇa sūryaḥ svāhetyarkavatībhyāmarkasamidhāvabhyādadhātyarkaḥ pavitrampavitramarko rajaso vimāna iti dvābhyāṃ

mṛtyustamaḥ

atha yadyāsandī śikyamagāraṃ vā dahyeta vaiśvānarībhiḥ samidho'bhyādadhyādvaiśvānaro na ūtyetyetenāṣṭārcenātha yadi vasatīvarīkalaśaḥ pānnejana ekadhanāḥ kumbheṣṭakāḥ kvathaneṣṭakā vā parāsicyeranyūpo vā bhidyeta raśanā vā chidyeta caṣālaṃ vā bhidyetaudumbarī vā bhidyeta grāvā vā bhidyeta dro ṇakalaśo vā dīryetānyadvā yajñe dārumayaṃ mṛnmayaṃ vā pātraṃ bhidyeta tatsvenaiva yajuṣā sva āyatane nidhāyopadhāyābhimantrayate bhūrāyurme dhārayata prāṇaṃ me dhārayata prajāṃ me dhārayata paśūnme dhārayata mā ma āyuḥ prāṇaḥ prajāḥ paśavaḥ parāsicyerannity

punarādheyamityeke'tha yadi patnī bahiḥ sīmāṃ punarādhānam
atha yadyātmani samārūḍheṣvavratyaṃ caredaraṇivināśoktadoṣo vā bhavedagnyādheyam
araṇivināśenāgnivināśa ukto'tha yadi grāmamaryādāṃ nadīṃ vāgnīnatihareyuretānevāgnīnhriyamāṇānanvārabheyātāṃ
pravasati yajamāne na patnī pravasati nātra prāyaścittambhinnayoniścedanvāhāryapacana udvāyedyā prakṛtistata āharaṇaṃ pṛthagaraṇī vā  
atha yadyekakapālaḥ parāvartate prajāpatervartanimanuvartasvetyadhvaryuḥ svasthāne pratiṣṭhāpayet
prati kṣatre pratitiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre viśvamanyābhivāvṛdha ityetābhyāṃ yajamāno'numantrayate'skāndyauḥ pṛthivīmaskānajani prājanītyetābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyāt
sam̐ sthite vaiśvānarīmiṣṭiṃ nirvapedvijñāyate ca yatprāṅpadyeta devalokamabhijayedyaddakṣiṇā pitṛlokaṃ yatpratyagrakṣām̐ si yajñam̐ hanyuryadudaṅmanuṣyalokamabhijayet
pratiṣṭhito hotavya ityatha yadi paśubandhaḥ somo vā lupyeta vaiśvānarīmiṣṭvā punaryajeta
sarvaṃ cetsutyamaharatikrāmetsamanvārabdhāḥ prāgupaveśanādapacchidyeransamāpya punaryajeta
somena dīkṣito na dadyānna juhuyānna pacenna japedityādita eva vibhajedityāhurvratopeto na snāyānnāpo'vagāheta na vāso jahyānna rajaḥ praplāvayet
sarvatra yajamānasyartvijāṃ ca yāvatkarma vratamupadiśanti nartvijāmārtvijyamanyatra vidyate na mahartvijām̐ samāso na sarvatra yajamānasyārtvijyamanyatra sattrāt
